text:
leo_csm: FYI — Zenova wants to move from 24 -> 44 seats at renewal and shorten to a 9-month term. Asking for consolidated invoice per region and to start new seats immediately on renewal (2026-06-01). Need pricing and PO flow.
tia_sales: ok, we need to confirm list price and whether they keep current committed pricing. any known discount guardrails for <12mo terms?
rahul_fin: finance prefers net45 for this account. they also asked for vendor code and whether we can do a single invoice with regional line items (US / APAC). vendor code request coming.
eve_legal: short-term discount policy: discounts <12mo are handled case-by-case. will need an amendment referencing renewal SOW. also check if seat add triggers seat true-up language.
leo_csm: current committed seats = 24, renewal date 2026-06-01. customer email says 20 additional seats on day 1 of renewal and wants a 9mo term to align with fiscal year.
zoe_enablement: if seats are active day 1 we will need 3 enablement blocks (30m each) plus onboarding playbook. estimate 2 SME hours. flagging calendar capacity.
infra-bot: note: Zenova org uses hosted-prod in ap-southeast and us-west regions. No Private deployment changes expected.
tia_sales: pricing thought — propose a term-proportionate discount: for 9mo apply 6% off ARR-equivalent vs 12mo list, plus onboarding credit for ramp seats. Rahul — ok on net45?
rahul_fin: net45 ok. vendor code VF-9912. For invoice split, we can emit a single invoice with two line items and two billing references, but PO must reference both entities or we need two POs. Customer prefers one PO referencing both entities. Note: accounting needs legal entity tax IDs for each line item.
eve_legal: we can accept a single PO referencing multiple billing entities only if they sign an entity allocation addendum. will draft amendment; also add early-termination clause for prorated refund.
leo_csm: customer asked if we can pro-rate the additional seats for 9 months only (no annual bill). propose this calc in thread so everyone is aligned.
zoe_enablement: scheduling note: if signed by 2026-05-20 we can onboard on 2026-06-03. otherwise onboarding slips 2 weeks.
tia_sales: action list:
- leo: confirm final signer list and send PO template to customer (due today)
- eve: draft 9mo amendment + entity allocation addendum (48h)
- rahul: prepare invoice template showing two line items and vendor code (48h)
- zoe: reserve enablement slots pending signature
leo_csm: pasting pro-rate example (assumes monthly billing for new seats):
```
added_seats = 20
monthly_price_per_seat = $120
months = 9
pro_rate_total = added_seats * monthly_price_per_seat * months
# = 20 * 120 * 9 = $21,600
term_discount = pro_rate_total * 0.06
net_due = pro_rate_total - term_discount
```
rahul_fin: looks good. will produce a sample invoice PDF and attach.
infra-bot: docsend link scanned; potential PII in uploaded doc "zenova-org-chart.xlsx" flagged. make sure to remove before attaching to external.
leo_csm: thanks infra-bot  will scrub before sharing.
eve_legal: posted draft amendment to shared drive, attaching link (internal). will highlight clause on refund calc and entity allocation.
tia_sales: small gotcha: Zenova procurement asked about a 30-day acceptance window for new seats. legal ok with acceptance window? @eve_legal
eve_legal: 30-day acceptance is fine but need explicit language about seat activation and billing start date in the amendment. will add.
zoe_enablement: confirmed SMEs for 06/03 onboarding (tentative). will convert to calendar invites once PO + signature confirmed.
leo_csm: update from customer: they sent PO but email bounced for one signer. sending corrected signers tonight. will update once DocuSign is queued.
rahul_fin: received tentative PO file in internal email. will verify tax IDs and produce invoice draft.
tia_sales: target sign date = 2026-05-20 to keep enablement cadence. if we miss that, push to 06/17.
eve_legal: will aim to finish redlines by 2026-05-18.
leo_csm: final note: capture customer enablement preference (async playbook + live Q&A) in SOW. zoe, can you ensure playbook update?
zoe_enablement: yes will update playbook and include Q&A slot.
leo_csm: thanks all. i'll post back once DocuSign goes out. :rocket:
